about: WWE 2K14 (Xbox 360) match-type ids: the value the type setter sub_822CA9C0 stores at M+8 (docs/systems/match_setup.md) and --wwe2k14_quick_type takes. Found by the Session 30 menu crawler: every PLAY entry leads to a setup screen whose menu id is 2000 + the type; checked against the five types known from match captures (0, 3, 23, 39, 49) and the rule types in match_setup.md (81 Inferno, 26-31 brawl). The type table holds 119 records: ids missing here are not reached from PLAY (e.g. 1, 2, 37 from Session 27, other modes). confidence high = captured or launched, medium = menu id only. Session 30: Quick Match of 60 / 81 needed two rule bytes the menus write (M+21 bit 0 cage, M+71 bit 0 Inferno fire; docs/systems/match_setup.md); src/scenario.h now writes them. Session 31: the other 48 PLAY types launched as Quick Matches (runs 2357-2404) and set high; "sides" = the team digit apply gives each slot (tag types alternate, handicaps put slot 0 alone); the steel-cage variants 61-63 get M+21=3 from their own type defaults (runs 2387-2389 and 2405 log 3 -> 3): only 60 needs the write.
